import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('magaza.db')
cur = conn.cursor()

# Test the median query
query = '''
WITH OrderTotals AS (
    SELECT m.sehir, SUM(sk.adet * sk.birim_fiyat) AS tutar
    FROM musteriler m
    JOIN siparisler s ON m.id = s.musteri_id
    JOIN siparis_kalemleri sk ON s.id = sk.siparis_id
    GROUP BY m.sehir, s.id
),
CityCounts AS (
    SELECT sehir, COUNT(*) AS siparis_sayisi
    FROM OrderTotals
    GROUP BY sehir
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
MedianPerCity AS (
    SELECT 
        c.sehir,
        c.siparis_sayisi,
        CASE WHEN c.siparis_sayisi % 2 = 1 THEN
            (SELECT tutar FROM OrderTotals o2 
             WHERE o2.sehir = c.sehir 
             ORDER BY o2.tutar 
             LIMIT 1 OFFSET ((c.siparis_sayisi - 1) / 2))
        ELSE
            (
                (SELECT tutar FROM OrderTotals o2 
                 WHERE o2.sehir = c.sehir 
                 ORDER BY o2.tutar 
                 LIMIT 1 OFFSET (c.siparis_sayisi / 2 - 1)) +
                (SELECT tutar FROM OrderTotals o2 
                 WHERE o2.sehir = c.sehir 
                 ORDER BY o2.tutar 
                 LIMIT 1 OFFSET (c.siparis_sayisi / 2))
            ) / 2
        END AS medyan
    FROM CityCounts c
)
SELECT sehir, siparis_sayisi, ROUND(medyan, 2) AS medyan
FROM MedianPerCity
ORDER BY medyan DESC, sehir ASC;
'''
cur.execute(query)
rows = cur.fetchall()
print(f'Columns: {[desc[0] for desc in cur.description]}')
for row in rows:
    print(row)
conn.close()

import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('magaza.db')
cur = conn.cursor()

query = '''
WITH OrderTotals AS (
    SELECT m.sehir, SUM(sk.adet * sk.birim_fiyat) AS tutar
    FROM musteriler m
    JOIN siparisler s ON m.id = s.musteri_id

CityOrderCounts AS (

    FROM OrderTotals
    GROUP BY sehir
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
OrderedOrders AS (
    SELECT o.sehir, o.tutar,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.sehir ORDER BY o.tutar) AS rn,
           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY o.sehir) AS total_count
    FROM OrderTotals o
),

    SELECT sehir, total_count,
        CASE WHEN total_count % 2 = 1 THEN
            MAX(CASE WHEN rn = (total_count + 1) / 2 THEN tutar END)

        END AS medyan
    FROM OrderedOrders
    GROUP BY sehir, total_count
)

FROM CityOrderCounts m
JOIN MedianCalc mc ON m.sehir = mc.sehir
ORDER BY medyan DESC, m.sehir ASC;
'''

    FROM musteriler m
    JOIN siparisler s ON m.id = s.musteri_id
    JOIN siparis_kalemleri sk ON s.id = sk.siparis_id
    GROUP BY m.sehir, s.id
),
CityOrderCounts AS (
    SELECT sehir, COUNT(*) AS siparis_sayisi
    FROM OrderTotals
    GROUP BY sehir
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
OrderedOrders AS (
    SELECT o.sehir, o.tutar,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.sehir ORDER BY o.tutar) AS rn,
           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY o.sehir) AS total_count
    FROM OrderTotals o
),
MedianCalc AS (
    SELECT sehir, total_count,
        CASE WHEN total_count % 2 = 1 THEN
            MAX(CASE WHEN rn = (total_count + 1) / 2 THEN tutar END)
        ELSE
            (MAX(CASE WHEN rn = total_count / 2 THEN tutar END) + MAX(CASE WHEN rn = total_count / 2 + 1 THEN tutar END)) / 2
